text: The Brouwer-Heyting-Kolmogorov (BHK) interpretation defines a proof of A→B as:
choices: a proof of A and a proof of B
a function taking proofs of A to proofs of B
a proof that A and B are equivalent
a proof that B implies A
explanation: BHK: proof of A→B = a method (function) transforming any proof of A into a proof of B. This is the intuitionistic semantics of implication.
